videos.title: How to use haptics with Adobe Premiere Pro on Logitech MX Master 4 | Logi Options+
videos.description:
Elevate your video editing workflow with the haptics-enabled Adobe Premiere Pro plugin on Logitech MX Master 4.

Learn how to install the plugin from Logi Marketplace and use the Haptic Sense Panel for immersive control and precision in Adobe Premiere Pro. The video covers clip alignments, clip handle manipulation, dragging an effect onto a clip, razor tool hover, snapping to keyframes, generative extend and export.

videos.title: You've Got Options | Actions SDK for C#, Node.js and haptics plugins | Logitech
videos.description:
Joe talks to Paul Fitzsimons, Global Software Product Manager for Logitech's SDK, about extending Logitech hardware with the Actions SDK.

Custom plugins extend what Logitech hardware can do, such as Adobe Photoshop tool shortcuts on the MX Creative Console, and enable two-way communication between software and hardware displays. The episode covers improvements to the C# documentation and onboarding, and the Node.js (JavaScript) SDK beta, designed for easier integration and standard plugin devel

videos.title: You've Got Options | How to use native Windows 11 haptics on Logitech MX Master 4
videos.description:
Unlock native Windows 11 haptic feedback on your Logitech MX Master 4 without needing additional software.

In this episode of You've Got Options, learn how Microsoft's native haptic support brings subtle, tactile vibration feedback directly to your MX Master 4 on Windows 11. Existing users can unlock this capability via a quick firmware update in Logi Options+. Discover how native haptic feedback works across Windows 11 OS actions as well as third-party creative apps like Concepts.
